en: Nighttime street scene in a European city after rain, showing a row of late‑19th/early‑20th‑century buildings with ornate facades. Shop windows are lit, including a bright storefront on the left with a neon sign, and another building with a red illuminated sign further along the street. A small kiosk stands near the curb, trees line the sidewalk, and the wet pavement reflects the lights and facades.
